_comment: Committed expectations for seam_suite.sh. A metric ABOVE its entry fails;
a missing entry means zero, which is where holes, flicker and the
`cracks` is the only metric with a non-zero entry, and it is not a
tolerance for a known defect -- it is the resolution of the instrument.
hole_scan is exact: a background pixel enclosed by terrain either is or is
not there, and it reads 0 at every pose. crack_scan INFERS 'the eye went
through the shell' from a depth profile, and a 3-6 px component on an
ordinary terrain crease presents the same way. Every surviving component
was located (seam_locate.py) and most are 1.5-11 m from the nearest tile
border of any level, i.e. not on a seam at all.
The numbers are the 2026-08-13 measurement rounded up by about half, so a
few pixels of run-to-run LOD variation does not read as a regression while
a real reopening still does. Re-measure and re-commit them when the
instrument or the world changes, and say which in the commit message.
